extracted_text:
Careers Desk, CityCare Multispeciality Hospital

Dear Candidate,
Congratulations! Your profile has been shortlisted for the post of Ward Coordinator (Healthcare Tele-Operations).

Monthly Salary: Rs 85,000/month
Work Mode: 100% Work from home
Immediate Joining. Limited seats available!

To secure your appointment, kindly reply within 2 hours and pay a refundable registration fee of Rs 2,999 via UPI for medical kit allotment.
Share the screenshot and transaction OTP on this WhatsApp number +91 98201 44521 for ID verification.

Click official portal link to verify candidate profile:
http://citycare-hospital-careers.xyz/apply

Note: Rs 2,999 is 100% refundable with first salary payout. Offer expires today!

reasons: .xyz top-level domain associated with high scam velocity
Unencrypted HTTP protocol used for sensitive hiring intake

red_flags.title: Advance Fee Demand via UPI
red_flags.detail: Demands Rs 2,999 advance registration fee. Legitimate hospitals never charge candidates to hire.

red_flags.title: Authentication OTP Harvesting
red_flags.detail: Explicitly requests candidate to share verification OTP over WhatsApp under the guise of ID verification.

red_flags.title: Artificial Time Pressure
red_flags.detail: Enforces false urgency ('reply within 2 hours', 'limited seats available') to bypass critical evaluation.

red_flags.title: Inflated Entry-Level Compensation
red_flags.detail: Offering Rs 85,000/month for an entry-level remote Ward Coordinator is 3.5x industry standard benchmarks.

red_flags.title: Newly Registered Phishing Host
red_flags.detail: citycare-hospital-careers.xyz is an unverified external domain unlinked to any accredited hospital group.

highlights.reason: Advance fee fraud: Legitimate employers never charge candidates
Direct attack vector: OTPs provide full account compromise
Coercive urgency tactic used to force hasty payments
Unrealistic compensation benchmark designed as clickbait
Look-alike hospital domain on high-risk .xyz TLD

ai.summary_en: High-confidence job scam engineered to extract advance UPI fees and steal secondary account authentication OTPs. The attacker impersonates hospital HR, promises an unrealistic salary, and redirects victims to an unverified .xyz credential-harvesting domain.
ai.summary_hi: Ye offer poori tarah nakli lagta hai. Asli hospital naukri ke liye kabhi registration fee ya UPI payment nahi maangta. Link mat kholo aur WhatsApp par OTP kabhi share mat karo.
